name: Bilhah (Rachel's slave woman)
title: Rachel's slave woman and mother of two tribes
summary: Bilhah was the slave woman of Rachel, Jacob's beloved wife. When Rachel could not have children, she gave Bilhah to Jacob as a secondary wife, and through her Dan and Naphtali were born. These two sons became the ancestors of two of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: Given to Rachel as a slave woman
keyEvents.description: Bilhah was given to Rachel as a slave woman by her father Laban when Rachel married Jacob.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Jacob's Concubine
keyEvents.description: When Rachel could not bear children, she gave Bilhah to Jacob as a concubine so that she might have children through her, in accordance with the customs of that time.

keyEvents.title: Bears Dan
keyEvents.description: Bilhah bore her first son Dan, and Rachel said that God had judged in her favor and given her a son.

keyEvents.title: Bears Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Bilhah bore her second son Naphtali, and Rachel said that she had struggled with her sister and prevailed.

keyEvents.title: Reuben's Sin with Bilhah
keyEvents.description: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn son, slept with Bilhah, which became known to Jacob and later cost Reuben his birthright.
